package.name: amr_fleet_core
package.description: Per-robot decentralized core for SIH26123: space-time reservation negotiation, dual deadlock defense (resource ordering + wait-for-graph), custom A* + spline global planner, Contract Net task allocation with RL bid-priority layer, heartbeat fault tolerance, and explainability logging. No robot is ever a leader — every collision/deadlock decision is computed independently from peer broadcasts.
